conflicts.permit: Pursuant to our vendor management program, we require all marketing service providers to have written contracts with us that require them to safeguard your information and prohibits them from selling, retaining, using or disclosing your information for any purpose other than for the specific purpose of performing the contract.
conflicts.prohibit: We do not share your information with third parties for their marketing purposes without your consent or without providing you the opportunity to opt-out of such sharing.
conflicts.situation: Sharing customer personal information with joint marketing partners for marketing purposes before obtaining consent or providing an opt-out opportunity.
conflicts.reason: One clause permits sharing under joint marketing arrangements governed by written contracts, while the next sentence flatly prohibits sharing for third-party marketing without prior consent or opt-out.
